statement: The record lists a refund value of **USD 23,000.00** against an amount paid of **USD 230.00**. I’m holding the refund because the recorded value appears erroneous; no refund was issued.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the refund "appears erroneous" by contrasting USD 23,000.00 against the USD 230.00 paid, and withholds the refund.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
